newsitem.title: KENYA: Kenya shilling stable in range-bound trading.
newsitem.headline: Kenya shilling stable in range-bound trading.

text.p: The Kenyan shilling held steady on Thursday trading within very tight ranges in a very quiet market, commercial bank dealers said.
The Central Bank of Kenya posted a shilling mean rate of 54.88 against the dollar unchanged from Wednesday, while against the pound the shilling posted a mean rate of 89.77 from 89.83.
"There is not much activity going on in the market. Weve seen inflows come in from horticulture, but the main importers,oil companies, have stopped buying," one dealer said.
Dealers said the shilling remained stuck at 54.70/80 levels and added that if the current trend persisted the market would see a slightly stronger shilling that is good for importers.
The shilling's near-term direction looked set for under 55 level, with 54.80 set to be the next psychological barrier, they said.
The money market remained liquid. Overnight rates were quoted below 10 percent for the third consecutive week.
